prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1389; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of lower back pain radiating to the left buttock without numbness or weakness in the lower extremities. Initial examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted lumbar range of motion, with pain on forward flexion and extension. Neurological examination was within normal limits, and straight leg raise testing was negative bilaterally. Imaging was not indicated at the time of initial evaluation given the absence of red flag symptoms.

Treatment consisted of sixteen outpatient visits over the course of care and included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise focused on core stabilization and lumbar mobility, and instruction in a home exercise program. Ice and heat modalities were used for symptom control, and short-term use of a muscle relaxant and an over-the-counter anti-inflammatory was recommended. Progress was steady, with reduced pain levels and improved range of motion noted at each reassessment.

At discharge, the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms, with occasional stiffness after prolonged sitting. Full lumbar range of motion was restored and strength testing was normal. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
